thread:
Lina: Quick FYI — procurement confirmed a partial H100 shipment arriving 2026-07-22 (8 units). ETA updated on vendor portal: https://vendor/ship/PO-3492. We still need 12 more units to hit our Q3 reserved target. Can someone take point on follow-up with vendor? @Ethan? :raising_hand:

Ethan: Happy to take chase. I'll email procurement and request an explicit ramp schedule + serial numbers. Can someone paste the committed vs target table here?

Priya: Short summary from the tracker (sheet link in thread): reserved target = 200 GPUs by Sep; currently 60 delivered/allocated. Open items: customs clearance window for EU racks (Vanessa handling), and firmware validation for the incoming H100s.

Jon: Cluster readiness update: racking crew finished PDUs for rows 5-8; network cabling for those racks starts in ~48h. We still need L2 config and VLAN map pushed before we can power and enroll nodes. @Zoe can you confirm VLAN mapping and tag scheme?

Zoe: VLAN mapping is done. I'll open PR with config and doc. PR 472 -> https://git/repo/infra-config/pull/472. Note: using tag format `redwood/dedicated:2026-07-batchA` for images per ops standard. Need infra review by EOD.

Lina: Also saw a firmware mismatch on one sample H100 during initial smoke — SRE flagged different microcode. Priya, what's the plan for firmware testing cadence so we don't roll bad images?

Priya: Plan: small canary run (2 GPUs per rack) that runs kernel + perf + inference smoke. Schedule is Wed 03:00 UTC. I'll record artifacts and link results to the runbook. If failures, we block enroll.

Jon: On capacity reservations from product: they requested 100 GPUs reserved for Dedicated customers starting 2026-08-01. With current allocations we only have 40 fully allocated. Proposal: do a tiered reservation: 40 guaranteed, 60 burst-eligible until additional hardware confirms. Thoughts?

Ethan: Tiered makes sense. We should notify Sales/CS with expected timelines and caveats. I'll draft the customer-facing note; Lina can you confirm SLA language (esp. burst wording)?

Lina: SLA is unchanged for fully reserved capacity. For the burst portion we need a clear "best-effort burst" disclaimer and a lead time estimate. I'll get Legal to review the wording — give me today to loop them in.

Zoe: Minor infra note — private deployment images must be tagged exactly per `redwood/dedicated:<yyyy-mm>-<batch>` to avoid CI promotion issues. PR 472 will follow that.

Lina: Can reviewers on PR 472 please @mention @Lina and @Ethan so we can unblock.

Ethan: Added both as reviewers on PR 472.

procure-bot: PO-3492 status changed -> In transit. Carrier tracking TX12345.

Vanessa: EU customs update: broker found a documentation mismatch; could add 3-5 days. I'm escalating with the broker and will update the sheet when I have a firm ETA.

Priya: Noted blocker — if customs adds >3 days we may need to shift the canary window by 48-72h. I'll prepare alternate schedule and smoke-test checklist.

Jon: Consolidated action items: 1) Ethan to chase vendor and send sales notification draft; 2) Zoe to get PR 472 merged and push VLAN config; 3) Priya to run firmware canary Wed and publish results; 4) Lina to confirm SLA/legal wording; 5) Vanessa to update customs ETA. I'll compile a short timeline/Gantt and post by EOD.

Zoe: ack :thumbsup:

Lina: Thanks all — if anything critical pops up please ping #oncall and drop updates here so I can keep legal + product in the loop.
